cases.title: 库存少算一件
cases.question: 为什么库存总数少了一件？
cases.description: 5 种零件合计应为 57 件，现在只输出 41。先运行，找出循环里的问题，只改 total_qty。
cases.starter:
parts = [
    {"name": "轴承", "qty": 12},
    {"name": "齿轮", "qty": 8},
    {"name": "电机", "qty": 15},
    {"name": "皮带", "qty": 6},
    {"name": "螺栓", "qty": 16},
]


def total_qty(items):
    total = 0
    for i in range(len(items) - 1):
        total += items[i]["qty"]
    return total


print(total_qty(parts))

check.test: assert total_qty(parts) == 57

cases.starter:
import threading
import time


def run(threads=4, times=200):
    counter = 0

    def add():
        nonlocal counter
        for _ in range(times):
            current = counter
            time.sleep(0.0005)
            current += 1
            counter = current

    pool = [threading.Thread(target=add) for _ in range(threads)]
    for t in pool:
        t.start()
    for t in pool:
        t.join()
    return counter


print(run())

check.test:

assert run(2, 100) == 200
